summary: Petrochina T03/L5E89 nudged to USD 1,330 CIF (L5D98 1,340); Jinneng 1,330, BOPP 1,340
China National Day holiday Oct 1-7 delays most deals/shipments to after the break
Domestic NSRP 114G VND 39,200/kg (flat); some traders undercut plants (Sabic copo 38-38.5k, SK homo 37.5k)
paras: The PP market this week is in a fairly tense tug-of-war. Early this week, offers for China's Petrochina PP yarn T03 and L5E89 to Vietnam were announced at USD 1,325/tonne/CIF, up USD 20-25/tonne from the previous week. Today, September 30, the distributor nudged its offer up a further USD 5/tonne to USD 1,330/tonne/CIF, and offered grade L5D98 at USD 1,340/tonne/CIF.
Offers for China's Jinneng PP yarn/injection to Vietnam today were also at USD 1,330/tonne/CIF, and BOPP at USD 1,340/tonne/CIF, up about USD 10-20/tonne from the previous week.

One distributor offered China's CHN Shenhua PP yarn L5E89 (coal-based) to Vietnam at USD 1,320/tonne/CIF, nonwoven PP at USD 1,345/tonne/CIF, and thinwall PP at USD 1,375/tonne/CIF. Donguan's PP random injection was offered to Vietnam at USD 1,435/tonne/CIF… All cargoes ship in mid-November 2026.

Also today, another distributor quoted re-export offers for Saudi Arabia's Sabic PP copolymer grades from Chinese ports to Vietnam at USD 1,415-1,435/tonne/CIF, depending on grade. It also offered re-exported PP random RG568MO of Borouge (UAE) origin from China to Vietnam at USD 1,495/tonne/CIF; re-exported Borouge PP copolymer RB707CR at USD 1,725/tonne/CIF; and re-exported Borouge PP copolymer BJ368MO at USD 1,495/tonne/CIF… with a delivery deadline (LSD) of November 15, 2026.

Last week, Sabic's distributor quoted settled prices for Sabic PP copolymer grades to Vietnam at USD 1,430-1,440/tonne/CIF, for October 2026 cargoes. The China re-export offers above are therefore still lower than Sabic's direct offer…

Even so, according to market sources, Chinese suppliers will enter the National Day holiday from October 1 through October 7, so most offers this week will be hard to close, and shipping will also be pushed back until after the holiday. Moreover, according to some Vietnamese customers, many cargoes contracted for import from China in previous weeks are also delayed and will arrive in mid-October, as Chinese suppliers have recently faced shortages of containers and vessels, port congestion from a spike in shipping demand, and high freight rates…

One major distributor, Chemdo, quoted a range of Chinese-origin PP products to Vietnam in VND: Jinneng PP yarn/injection grades were offered at VND 39,600-39,900/kg including VAT in the north; ZPC PP yarn/injection at VND 41,400-41,600/kg including VAT, ZPC PP copolymer K8003/K8009 at VND 41,700/kg including VAT, and ZPC nonwoven PP S2040 at VND 42,000/kg including VAT; Grand Resource PP yarn/injection at VND 40,600/kg including VAT and Grand Resource PP random grades at VND 42,000-42,500/kg including VAT; Yulong PP yarn T30S at VND 41,600/kg including VAT; and Ningmei PP yarn/injection 1102K/1100N at VND 40,000-40,200/kg including VAT and Ningmei PP Film 2500HY at VND 40,200/kg including VAT…

“Thus, offers for Chinese-origin PP yarn/injection/fibre and Film were commonly VND 39,600-41,600/kg including VAT, and offers for PP copolymer and random commonly VND 41,700-42,500/kg including VAT… The offer levels from this distributor are considered too high relative to the general price level and buyers' willingness to accept,” a source analyzed.

In domestic trading, today NSRP's leading distributor Marubeni offered PP 114G for container delivery at VND 39,200/kg including VAT, flat from last week. In the market, settled transaction prices for NSRP's PP 114G were still commonly at VND 39,500-39,800/kg including VAT, flat since the start of the week. NSRP's PP injection grade 105G is scarcer, so offers were higher, at around VND 40,000-40,200/kg including VAT.

In the south, the Hyosung Vina plant also quoted PP injection at up to VND 41,000/kg including VAT for retail buyers, although PP yarn offers were held at VND 39,500-39,600/kg including VAT (after a deep cut late last week)…

Notably, some traders are currently selling PP at prices below the plants' direct offers. In the north, for example, some sources said leading distributor Stavian was offering Sabic PP copolymer 36MK10, 37MK10 and 310MK10 at only VND 38,000-38,500/kg including VAT; even a smaller trading firm was offering at this level, although Sabic's distributor's selling price last week was as high as VND 40,500-41,000/kg including VAT. Similarly, one seller offered South Korea's SK PP homopolymer at only VND 37,500/kg including VAT and SK PP random at VND 38,500/kg including VAT…

Also in the north, one seller was recorded offering SCG (Thailand)-origin PP injection at VND 39,000/kg including VAT. For far-forward cargoes, one major distributor offered China's Jinneng PP yarn/injection HP550J/HP500N at VND 38,600-38,800/kg including VAT, for a cargo expected to arrive at port in early November.

summary: Lotte HDPE Film & yarn offered at USD 1,400 CIF; STL FS7000 fell USD 40 to 1,340-1,350
China holiday + delayed prior cargoes (mid-Oct arrival) keep import demand below last year
Spot Sabic LLDPE/HDPE Film held VND 42,000-43,000/kg; LDPE high at 46,000-48,000/kg
paras: Yesterday, September 29, the distributor of South Korea's Lotte offered HDPE Film and yarn to Vietnam both at USD 1,400/tonne/CIF. The HDPE yarn offer was up to USD 100/tonne higher than the settled price Lotte announced on September 12. The distributor also offered South Korea's Lotte Hyundai LDPE Film to Vietnam at USD 1,550/tonne/CIF, and Lotte Hyundai EVA at USD 1,500-1,520/tonne/CIF. Meanwhile, offers for STL HDPE Film FS7000 to Vietnam fell sharply by USD 40/tonne from the previous week, to USD 1,340-1,350/tonne/CIF…
Today, September 30, one distributor offered a fairly wide range of PE products of various origins, re-exported from China to the Vietnamese market.

Specifically, for LLDPE, re-export offers for LLDPE Film/injection grades of Sabic and Qamar (Saudi Arabia) and Equate (Kuwait) origin to Vietnam ranged from USD 1,300-1,355/tonne/CIF, depending on grade; re-export offers for Exxon Mobil Singapore-origin LLDPE Film were at USD 1,355; and re-export offers for Ceterne and Plaslene (US)-origin LLDPE Film were at USD 1,295-1,315/tonne/CIF. For mLLDPE, re-export offers for Exxon Mobil mLLDPE grades were commonly at USD 1,385/tonne/CIF, while a few Exxon and Sabic mLLDPE grades were offered at USD 1,455-1,465/tonne/CIF.

For HDPE, re-export offers for HDPE Film grades of Sabic, Qamar, Qatar and Chevron (US) origin were commonly at USD 1,335-1,345/tonne/CIF; re-export offers for Saudi Arabia's Sabic HDPE Film grade FJ00952 were higher, at USD 1,435/tonne/CIF; Sabic's HDPE blow B5428 was offered at USD 1,285/tonne/CIF, and US Dow's HDPE blow at USD 1,335/tonne/CIF…

For LDPE, re-export offers for LDPE Film of Formosa and Certene (US) origin were at USD 1,525-1,535/tonne/CIF; re-export offers for Borouge (UAE) LDPE Film at USD 1,555-1,615/tonne/CIF depending on grade; and re-export offers for Qatar LDPE Film at USD 1,670-1,695/tonne/CIF depending on grade…

Offers from China were fairly numerous, but Chinese suppliers will enter the National Day holiday from October 1 through October 7, so most offers this week will be hard to close, and shipping will also be pushed back until after the holiday. Moreover, many cargoes contracted for import from China in previous weeks are also delayed and will arrive in mid-October, amid shortages of containers and vessels, port congestion from a spike in shipping demand, and high freight rates…

A major domestic distributor said demand for PE import contracts is weaker than in the same period last year, even though this time of year normally marks the start of the year-end peak season. This is partly because price levels remain too high (though they have cooled slightly since last week); and partly because demand for finished goods is also slow, with many manufacturers cutting operating rates, prioritizing use of existing inventories and waiting for cheap US-origin PE cargoes expected to arrive from mid-October…

Domestically, today one major distributor offered a range of PE products for late-October to early-November delivery (delivery window October 20-November 15), with northern-market quotations VND 500/kg lower than the southern market. Among these, Qamar (Saudi Arabia) HDPE Film F1 was offered in the north at VND 40,000/kg including VAT, and Qamar's LLDPE Film FD21HS at VND 40,400/kg including VAT… expected for late-October delivery. These offers are highly competitive, since spot offers for F1 and FD21HS currently range from VND 42,000-43,000/kg including VAT.

Similarly, this distributor offered other Middle Eastern-origin LLDPE and HDPE Film grades (such as Sabic's HDPE FJ00952, Saudi Arabia's Marlex TR144 and Equate Kuwait's LLDPE Film 7087) commonly in the range of VND 40,000-40,500/kg for late-October to early-November delivery; Sabic's 222WJA was offered at VND 41,500-42,000/kg including VAT for mid-November delivery; and ZPC (China)-origin LLDPE Film grades were also offered at VND 39,700-40,300/kg including VAT for late-October delivery. For LDPE, Sabic's LDPE Film 2023JN was offered at VND 47,500/kg including VAT for late-October delivery…

“The above distributor's offers are up VND 300-500/kg from late last week and are considered high relative to the general price level. For Chinese-origin LLDPE film, for example, late-October cargoes are now mostly offered by northern traders at VND 38,500-39,000/kg including VAT,” a source said.
The source added that the PE market is moving in a fairly complicated fashion: after falling deeply last week and easing further early this week, it has shown signs of rising again since yesterday.

On the spot market, offer prices for PE products this week were largely holding flat, as trading was fairly slow. Offers for Saudi Arabia's Sabic LLDPE Film were commonly holding in the VND 42,000-43,000/kg including VAT range, with HDPE Film also fluctuating within this range. LDPE Film of Sabic, Tasnee, PTT and Lotte Titan origin… held offers at high levels of VND 46,000-48,000/kg including VAT.
Russia's Sibur distributor also had a small volume of HDPE Film offered at Hai Phong port, at a fairly high offer price of VND 40,000/kg including VAT…

summary: Chinese oil-based ~USD 840, coal-based ~790 CIF, then stopped offering ahead of holiday
North US/Thai oil-based cut to VND 24,200/kg (-300); coal SG-5 down to 23,000-23,500
AGC Vina cut major-customer prices VND 400-500 to 22,300-22,500 excl. VAT (24,084-24,300 incl.)
paras: In a survey today, September 30, some Chinese PVC distributors quoted offers up about USD 10/tonne from the start of the week, with oil-based PVC offered at USD 840/tonne/CIF and coal-based PVC at around USD 790/tonne/CIF… However, by the afternoon distributors had stopped offering, mainly because China begins a week-long holiday from October 1, so most transactions and shipments were delayed until after the holiday.

In contrast to this, domestically, in the north today, some PVC buyers said they received offers for US- and Thai-origin oil-based PVC both at VND 24,200/kg including VAT, excluding freight, down VND 300/kg from the start of the week.

For coal-based PVC, offers for coal-based SG-5 PVC of Yihua and Zhongtai (China) origin… in the north have fallen to VND 23,000-23,500/kg including VAT. Notably, one fairly large manufacturer said it had closed an import of Yihua SG-5 PVC at only VND 22,500/kg including VAT, for October delivery.

This development further confirms that, after price-raising efforts over the past two weeks that failed to generate many deals, many sellers have now had to accept price cuts on both oil-based and coal-based PVC.

In the south, many traders have also cut prices for oil-based PVC such as Thailand-origin SG660 and US-origin SE950/SE1000… to VND 24,000-24,500/kg including VAT, down VND 300-500/kg from last week. Some sellers have in fact been recorded cutting oil-based PVC to below VND 24,000/kg including VAT.

Earlier, at the start of the week, producer AGC Vina (ACVN) announced an adjustment to its selling prices for major customers, cutting prices by VND 400-500/kg from last week to VND 22,300-22,500/kg excluding VAT depending on volume. With the full 8% VAT, the offer is VND 24,084-24,300/kg including VAT…
